site.name: Eureka Mine
overview: Eureka Mine is a documented historic tungsten property in Boulder County's tungsten district, preserved in federal topographic mapping and state and federal mining records.

timeline.text: State and federal mining references document development and production at the Eureka Mine within the Boulder County tungsten district.

moreHistory: Federal mapping preserves the Eureka Mine locality at approximately 40.00193, -105.41333. The mapped point identifies the historic mine area without claiming that a surviving shaft or portal has been field-surveyed.
